scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev -- --host"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:init: set PGCLIENTENCODING=UTF8&& psql -U postgres -d tripmate -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f server/db/schema.sql && set PGCLIENTENCODING=UTF8&& psql -U postgres -d tripmate -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f server/db/seed.sql
scripts.db:reset: set PGCLIENTENCODING=UTF8&& psql -U postgres -d tripmate -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f server/db/schema.sql && set PGCLIENTENCODING=UTF8&& psql -U postgres -d tripmate -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f server/db/seed.sql
